{"claim_1": {"real": true, "severity": "critical", "confidence": 0.97, "why": "The code explicitly takes the `if classical_layer.encrypted_routing_info.is_empty()` shortcut and returns `(None, payload_plaintext)` (treating as destination) without decrypting or authenticating the routing_info under the relay's derived key."}, "claim_2": {"real": true, "severity": "critical", "confidence": 0.92, "why": "The payload plaintext is only AEAD-authenticated under the key derived from this relay's static-private DH; an off-path attacker cannot forge a valid `payload_nonce` AEAD tag, so they cannot arbitrarily read arbitrary traffic. However, by crafting an envelope with empty `encrypted_routing_info` plus a payload ciphertext from a DIFFERENT context (e.g. previous onion to this destination, or a layer the relay is the final hop of), the attacker can splice a valid destination payload into a stream where this relay is a *non-final* hop — turning a non-final relay into a final one and causing it to deliver a payload it was not supposed to terminate, breaking end-to-end routing/authentication properties (routing/auth integrity). It is not an off-path confidentiality break of arbitrary messages, but it is a real off-path reachability/auth break — severity high (not catastrophic confidentiality), not 'limited to medium'."}, "claim_3": {"real": true, "severity": "high", "confidence": 0.9, "why": "There is no explicit, AEAD-authenticated 'final hop' marker; finality is inferred solely from the empty/non-empty ciphertext of the routing_info field, which is an unauthenticated attacker-controlled wire byte distinguishing a final from a non-final hop."}, "claim_4": {"real": true, "severity": "medium", "confidence": 0.85, "why": "The non-empty branch feeds the decrypted routing_info_plaintext into a bincode parse (per the '// bincode-parse next_hop from routing_info_plaintext' comment) without any visible length cap; bincode length prefixes are attacker-controlled and can request large allocations (memory-exhaustion DoS) on this relay."}, "claim_5": {"real": true, "severity": "medium", "confidence": 0.8, "why": "AAD is `&payload_nonce_bytes` only; routing_info is not bound to payload, and routing_info vs payload ciphertexts (or their AAD) can be swapped/substituted across layers/nonces without breaking the AEAD tag, since each is independently keyed-bound solely to its own nonce and not to layer position or peer identity."}}
